--- Email 3 (change your trajectory, put yourself out there) ---
￼
￼
Hey Shivam,  
Roxy here. You may have noticed I've been on the road a lot last month. When I decided to put myself out there, I *really* put myself out there. And I am so grateful that I get to represent Randstad Digital in the process.
 
Thanks to the support of our community and my family, I started submitting CFPs for conferences. It can feel intimidating but you just have to do it. Sometimes you get a no, sometimes you get a no with feedback, and sometimes folks will say YES.
 
If you're thinking about speaking at events, start small. Many local meetups love a guest speaker. This gives you a chance to see what works and what doesn't. Virtual talks are great, too!
 
Don't take it personally. This one is hard at first, but just like applying for a job, there are many other folks out there with more experience. Just keep at it and someone will see the value in what you have to offer.
 
Showing up in person can change your trajectory whether you're searching for a new role or just looking to grow your career. Meet the folks who run the events. Chat with them about what they are looking for. Develop a relationship for real. Attend, volunteer, be seen.
 
Say yes before you are ready and then run to the Discord to tell your community. We are rooting for you. 🙂
￼
